newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat closes mixed, bear spreads noted.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat closes mixed, bear spreads noted.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed mixed with small-lot bear spreading boosting the deferreds relative to the nearbys in early dealings, traders said.
But a late collapse in CBOT soybeans and nearby CBOT wheat contracts spurred late local and scattered commission house selling, they said.
Traders said there was some talk about potential delays in seeding spring wheat due to the heavy snowpack and possible related flooding and wet fields this spring.
Traders also said they were keeping a wary eye on CBOT corn and soybeans. Corn Tuesday surged to four month highs on aggressive fund buying.
MGE spring wheat futures closed 1-3/4 cents per bushel lower to 3/4 higher, with March up 3/4 at $3.91-1/2.
